channel.title: Cheryl's Newscast
channel.description: Three short news briefings a day — morning, midday, evening — read by Cheryl Tunt in her trademark deadpan. Private feed.
channel.itunes:author: Topher

item.title: Morning briefing — Monday, November 9
item.description: Stories in this edition: • Lead update: Krakow gunman died in hospital early Monday after police shot him Saturday; Tusk calls attack terrorism, investigation into whether he acted alone continues • World: New Delhi PM2.5 hit 879 micrograms per cubic meter after Diwali, more than 58x the WHO daily limit • World: Taiyuan high-rise fire in northern China killed 14, 38 hospitalized, cause under investigation • World: COP31 opened in Antalya — nearly 200 countries, Türkiye hosts, Australia leads negotiations, electrification target 35% by 2035 • US: Sanders open to impeaching RFK Jr. after Sen.-elect Annie Andrews calls for his removal; HHS defends Kennedy • US: NASA opens up to $10B lunar cargo lander competition and plans PROMISE rover for the lunar south pole in 2028 • US: Biden scales back book tour for Promise Me, America following his cancer diagnosis • Fun fact: Detached scarlet sea cucumber tissue kept living, healing and growing on its own for more than three years • Tech: Anthropic reportedly agreed to $3.4B for 1.7 GW of gas generators for data centers, per FT; Reuters could not verify • Tech: Hackers forced European supermarket refrigeration controllers into defrost mode, stores threw food away • Gaming: Godzilla: Destroy All Monsters Melee Remastered launched at $29.99 with 4K and online matchmaking • Gaming: Castlevania: Symphony of the Night SNES homebrew demo released, AI-free; MediEvil fan recomp hits 1.0 • Homelab: Proxmox lab consolidation cut draw from nearly 300W to under 100W, with TrueNAS-as-VM controller caveat • Stocks: Friday close — S&P 500 +0.31% to 7,376.86, Nasdaq +1.09% to 24,579.42, Dow -0.46% • Stocks: Nvidia slipped about 3% overnight amid reports of a board investigation into a foreign targeting claim • Stocks: Goldman lifted Datadog target to $171 from $158, kept Sell; Bitcoin near $73,954, down about 2.4% • Local: Lowell police investigate Sunday gunfire that struck a home on Cumberland Road, no injuries • Local: City of Lights returns Nov 28 for Lowell's bicentennial, Jackson Street to City Hall at 4:30pm

item.title: Evening briefing — Sunday, November 8
item.description: Stories in this edition: • Lead: Egypt train collision in Giza — 7 killed, 112+ injured, investigation ordered • World: New Zealand election deadlock — coalition on 67 of 131 seats, 399k special votes uncounted, result Nov 27 • World: COP31 opens Monday in Antalya — Türkiye hosts, Australia leads negotiations, finance fight ahead • World: Britain's Remembrance Sunday — King Charles at the Cenotaph; M20 in Kent reopened after 30-vehicle fog pile-up • US: Stephen Miller starts as chief of staff Monday — Jeffries says Democrats won't work with him, Garcia floats probes, Sanders unworried • US: Previously unknown North Atlantic right whale calf found off Quebec — season's calves now 24, best since 2009 • US: Philadelphia protest at Jewish-owned businesses drowned out by counterprotesters, shut down early • Fun fact: Infernogallus, the turkey-sized fruit-eating 'hell chicken' dinosaur from Hell Creek • Tech: Microsoft Paint RCE (CVE-2026-83844, 8.1) — fix is Store-only, build 11.2609.401.0 • Tech: Viasat has lost over 80% of its US satellite subscribers to Starlink • Gaming: Pikmin 4 Switch 2 Edition and Metaphor: ReFantazio land Nov 12; Football Manager 27 and Warhammer Survivors Nov 10 • Gaming: Original Xbox achievements appearing early on profiles before any Microsoft announcement • Homelab: Proxmox gains Lightbits NVMe-over-TCP shared storage integration (open plugin, commercial backend) • Stocks: Bitcoin slipped to ~$74,500 (-1.6%) late Sunday; futures reopen 6pm ET • Stocks: Ethereum ~$2,132 (-4.5%), Solana ~$86.73 (-2.7%); Fear & Greed at 28 • Stocks: Datadog closed Friday at $179.04 (+2.54%), still down ~23.9% on the week • Local: Lowell License Commission adopts restaurant/bar rules — 35% food revenue threshold, new one-day 18-20 permit • Local: Lowell council votes to release Flock camera executive-session minutes, sends policy to city manager

item.title: Midday briefing — Sunday, November 8
item.description: Stories in this edition: • Krakow update: national mourning begins, prosecutors open terrorist-offence investigation, family victims confirmed, trumpet call suspended first time since 1939, wounded officer fighting for his life • Israel: President Herzog formally gives Gadi Eisenkot the mandate to form a government, 28 days to build a coalition • Ukraine: fresh Russian energy strikes leave 600,000+ without power in Dnipropetrovsk and 250,000 in Kharkiv • Japan: magnitude 5.7 earthquake in central Japan injures at least 22, strongest Shizuoka shaking in 107 years • Berkshire Hathaway: Q3 operating profit falls about 6 percent, $9.6B in buybacks, $377B cash pile • US employers dropping GLP-1 weight-loss drug coverage, from 43 percent to 33 percent of large employers • Bella Rose the dog home in Soldotna, Alaska after 70 days lost in bear country • Unhinged fun fact: Earth has a temporary couch-sized mini moon, asteroid 2026 QQ8, leaving in December • Chainalysis breach exposed credentials, password hashes and live tokens for all customers • CISA adds actively exploited SonicWall SSLVPN flaw to the Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog • Ocarina of Time remake datamine hints at Master Quest return; WoW Forever sets concurrent-player launch record • Proxmox VE 9.2 dynamic load balancer rebalances clusters automatically • Stocks/crypto: Bitcoin near $76,064, Ethereum $2,236, Solana $89.20, futures reopen 6pm, CPI Tuesday • Lowell corner: Hack Club teen game jam at Lowell Makes November 14-15, no experience required, free food • Merrimack Valley's Funniest Person final set for next Saturday at Hungry Traveler in Salisbury

item.title: Morning briefing — Sunday, November 8
item.description: Stories in this edition: • Lead update: Krakow — three bodies found at the suspect's home bring connected deaths to nine; PM Tusk calls the shooting a terrorist attack, motive not established • World: India and the EU conclude negotiations on India's association with Horizon Europe • World: Germany's IG Metall says over 413,000 workers joined 2,800 strike actions over a 5% pay demand; talks resume Monday • World: Nigeria's under-17 women beat Japan 2-1 in Rabat for their first world title • US: Two Senate races still unsettled — Colom leads Hyde-Smith in Mississippi's unofficial count; Peltola sues over the Alaska count • US: Full trial results show heart drug pelacarsen no better than placebo • US: Trump says he is offering UFC chief Dana White the White House press secretary job; acceptance unconfirmed • Fun fact: Asteroid 1998 KY26 is accelerating mysteriously and is too warm for the hidden-ice theory; Hayabusa2 arrives in 2031 • Tech: Binance CFO Kaiser Ng leaves and Justin Yek takes over, nine days after the $6.3 billion hack; Binance says the transition was planned • Tech: The New York Times reports an approved Nvidia H200 buyer operates from an empty office, with owners tied to a blacklisted firm • Gaming: GTA 6 leak points to 55 trophies and achievements; launches November 19, preloads November 10, Rockstar has not confirmed • Gaming: Ocarina of Time remake producer says the Water Temple is now its best version, with one-button Iron Boots and a free camera • Homelab: Buoyant open-sources Kinference, a vLLM-on-Kubernetes inference control plane, Apache 2.0 and still alpha • Stocks: Bitcoin closed Saturday at $75,868, up 0.03%, in the narrowest range in a month; Ethereum $2,240, Solana $89.81 • Stocks: Spot Bitcoin funds have bled about $1.28 billion in November through Friday, including $411.9 million on Friday • Local: Lowell gets $5 million to clean up a 5.7-acre VFW Highway brownfield site, plus $500,000 to assess five old mill sites • Local: New England Classic Gaming group — a MintyNES adapter lets an Intellivision use NES, SNES and Famicom controllers, light guns included

item.title: Evening briefing — Saturday, November 7
item.description: Stories in this edition: • Lead: Krakow market square shooting — six killed, at least fifteen wounded, suspect shot and detained, city mourning through Wednesday • World: Iran's Revolutionary Guard lifts its self-imposed 2,000 km ballistic missile range limit, no longer-range deployment shown • World: Israel's President Herzog gives opposition leader Gadi Eisenkot first chance to form a government, 67 recommendations to Netanyahu's 46 • World: New Zealand election too close to call — preliminary coalition 67 seats, official result not due until November 27 • US: Dearborn police say federal immigration operation arrested three people Saturday with no advance notice to the department • US: Unknown baby North Atlantic right whale found off Canada — 24th calf of the season, best count since 2009 • US: The 300-million-year-old "oldest octopus" fossil from Illinois reclassified as a nautilus relative • Fun fact: Infernogallus, the turkey-sized "hell chicken" dinosaur, is the first known fruit-eating dinosaur • Tech: Tesla to wind down Cybertruck production in Texas mid-next year to make room for Cybercab • Tech: Blue Origin's New Glenn return to flight slips to January after May pad explosion; new third stage and engine unveiled • Gaming: Tomb Raider IV–VI Remastered free for PlayStation Plus subscribers until December 1 • Gaming: Ratchet & Clank: Ranger Rumble development ended before worldwide launch; delisted November 21, servers close next May • Homelab: Proxmox gets a native Lightbits NVMe-over-TCP shared storage plugin • Stocks: Bitcoin near $75,800 flat on the day, down 2.3% on the week after Friday's $1.27B liquidation wave; Ethereum near $2,242, Solana $89.87; spot Bitcoin funds bled ~$870M in the first four November sessions • Local: 19-year-old UMass Lowell student Daniel Darris-O'Connor of Billerica beats 16-year incumbent Marc Lombardo by 438 votes for a Massachusetts House seat • Local: Merrimack Valley's Funniest Person Contest Night 4 tonight at 8 at the Hungry Traveler in Salisbury, per Merrimack Valley Eats

item.title: Midday briefing — Saturday, November 7
item.description: Stories in this edition: • Lead: Russia launches 36 ballistic missiles and 172 drones at Kyiv overnight; at least 2 killed, Northern Bridge and nuclear power lines damaged, Abu Dhabi talks Tuesday • Paraguay update: President Alliana pledges to compensate nearly 3M Ueno Bank depositors; attorney general opens three criminal investigations • Iran: second night of reported explosions on Qeshm Island; Iran claims a US drone downed, no US confirmation; Qatar says mediation intact • Europe hoax bomb threats enter a third wave, 18 more flights disrupted, still no explosives found • Kenya launches a 10-year, $160M conservation program covering 17.3M hectares across 31 counties • Houston mayor orders police to limit cooperation with federal immigration agents, breaking with state policy • Measles update: unvaccinated Wisconsin infant dies, third measles death in a week; US status review next week • Rep. Massie says he will file a Hegseth impeachment resolution early next week • Unhinged fun fact: Earth has a temporary second moon, a roughly 3-foot rock called 2026 QQ8, leaving in December • Tech: investors press Anthropic to cut its $1.5 trillion listing valuation • Tech: OpenAI rates its new GPT-6 Cyber model 'critical' after it found hundreds of software flaws • Gaming: EA relaunches 25 classic PC games on Steam and GOG, including Road Rash, Ultima and Theme Hospital • Gaming: Bethesda names The Elder Scrolls VI 'Sentinel', set in Hammerfell, still no release date • Homelab: Proxmox 9.2's dynamic load balancer auto-rebalances VMs and containers across cluster nodes • Stocks: Berkshire Hathaway Q3 operating earnings fall 5.8% to $12.7B; $9.6B in buybacks and a record $377.4B cash pile; Bitcoin near $75,954 • Local: Lowell City Council approves $1.5M to hire 14 new firefighters amid station brownouts • Local: Highlands group posts jacket giveaway at 99 Moody Street until 2pm today and a Tyler Park toy drive on November 14

item.title: Morning briefing — Saturday, November 7
item.description: Stories in this edition: • Lead: Paraguay Senate removes President Santiago Peña 44-0 on Friday over Ueno Bank collapse and places him under house arrest per AP — bank held ~3M customers and ~$850M in public money; VP Pedro Alliana sworn in through Aug 2028; Peña denies wrongdoing and is due before prosecutors Saturday morning • World: Hoax bomb threats disrupt European flights for a second day — at least 18 flights disrupted Friday per The Guardian, Irish and British media also threatened, no explosives found, UK calls it a malicious hoax, no link established • World: Pope Leo XIV arrives in Montevideo to start a 12-day Uruguay, Argentina and Peru tour, his first major trip since lung cancer surgery last month — Vatican says healed, no further treatment; 36 speeches, 10 cities, Cusco at 11,000 feet • World: Funerals begin for 8 killed Thursday in a shooting spree across three villages in Turkey's Afyonkarahisar province, including two teachers per local reports — suspect captured in neighboring Eskisehir per governor's office, one seriously injured, no motive given • US: US measles cases pass 5,000 — CDC reports 5,182 confirmed cases as of Nov 5 in 45 states plus DC, highest since 1991 and more than double 2025; death count disputed (CDC says 4, states report more); measles-free status review next week • US: October payrolls jump 165,000 against forecasts near 65,000 per BLS — unemployment edges down to 4.1%, December Fed hike odds rise to about 78% • US: Trump names Stephen Miller White House chief of staff effective Monday Nov 9, replacing Susie Wiles who moves to his political operation; DOJ drops its attempt to set aside 20,000 California ballots • Fun fact: Earwax is both slippery and sticky and deters insects — Soft Matter study found fire ants lose footing on earwax, get it stuck to their bodies and groom frantically; 36 samples from pigs, sheep, dogs, cows, rabbits and humans, Georgia Tech team • Tech: Physical Superintelligence says a non-public Anthropic model proved the 2008 Aaronson-Ambainis quantum conjecture with the proof checked in Lean — humans still must confirm the proved statement matches the original problem • Tech: Nvidia says its open-source AI Aerial and Sionna 5G/6G research tools passed 1 million downloads, adoption up tenfold in a year, used by more than 8,000 research institutions; no commercial 6G date • Gaming: Original Xbox achievements appear to be leaking onto Series X|S profiles for games like Destroy All Humans and Panzer Dragoon Orta — Microsoft has not announced them yet • Gaming: GTA VI has reportedly made about $751M in digital preorders, about 7.71M copies with PlayStation at 74%, per Sensor Tower estimates not confirmed by Rockstar — launches Nov 19, preloads start Nov 10 • Homelab: XDA-tracked Proxmox lab cuts from five boxes drawing nearly 300W to three boxes under 100W — full consolidation was walked back after rebooting the single host took the NAS down with it • Stocks: Friday close — Nasdaq Composite +1.09% to 24,579.42, S&P 500 +0.31% to 7,376.86, Dow -0.46% to 51,285.73; for the week S&P -2.7% and Nasdaq -3.4% • Stocks: AMD +11.04% and Nvidia +2.78% to $186.64 led the chip bounce; Datadog +2.54% to $179.04 from a $174.60 Thursday close • Local: Lowell receives $7.5M in state HDIP housing tax credits, the largest share statewide, supporting 132 housing units including at Mass Mills IV, per Lowell Sun reporting • Local: Lowell's Household Hazardous Waste Day is today, Saturday 9am-noon at DPW, 1365 Middlesex Street, per the Lowell Highlands group; the Highlands hold their final meeting of the year Monday night at Lowell Catholic Auditorium

item.title: Evening briefing — Friday, November 6
item.description: Stories in this edition: • Lead: Friday close — Nasdaq +1.09% and S&P +0.31% bounce, Dow -0.46%; worst week since June • World: Novartis says two child tumour cases linked to Zolgensma gene therapy, regulators reviewing • World: EU delays fossil-fuel import methane deadlines by one year • World: Nigeria court nullifies ADC leadership and voids Atiku Abubakar's candidacy • US: Trump names Stephen Miller as next White House chief of staff from Nov 9 • US: Federal judge temporarily blocks construction of the planned 250-foot triumphal arch • US: Three men charged in alleged AI CEO-impersonation fraud over $100 million, per DOJ indictment • Unhinged fun fact: Alaska black bear eating salmon under a waterfall wins the 2026 Shower Beer Award • Tech: Google, Meta and TikTok sue to block California's youth social media law • Tech: NASA unveils the reconfigurable X-70 Fractal experimental plane • Gaming: Anbernic RG DDS dual-screen AI handheld, preorders from $284.99, ships Dec 10 • Homelab: Home Assistant 2026.11 is out; 92k GitHub stars, 22k+ commits in a year • Stocks: Closing indices and the VIX at 25.58, down 9.23% • Stocks: Datadog $179.04 (+2.54%), Nvidia $186.64 (+2.78%), AMD $449.04 (+11.04%) • Local: Friends of Tyler Park toy drive, Sat Nov 14, 1–3pm, for the Lowell Police toy drive • Local: Highlands Neighborhood Association final meeting of the year, Mon Nov 9 at Lowell Catholic

item.title: Midday briefing — Friday, November 6
item.description: Stories in this edition: • Lead: October payrolls beat forecasts at 165,000, unemployment 4.1%, and markets bounced after Thursday's rout • World: Paraguay's President Pena resigned over the Ueno Bank collapse and asked for 72 hours to prepare his Senate impeachment defence • World: Pope Leo left Rome for a 12-day Uruguay, Argentina and Peru tour three weeks after lung cancer surgery • World: Asia selloff spread — Nikkei down 6%, Taiwan down 4.51%, SK Hynix down 9.4% • US: Michigan consumer sentiment cratered to 51 while inflation expectations jumped to 4.3% • US: Trump heads to Florida for his first trip since the midterm rout, speaking at Kennedy Space Center Friday evening • US: Mississippi Senate race heads to an extended count with Colom ahead by roughly 1,800 votes • Fun fact: A survey of Angola's Lisima plateau documented 70+ previously unrecorded species, including a crab spider that glows blue under UV light • Tech: Tesla renamed its AI chips the SI line, claiming SI6 delivers 80x the compute of SI4, plus a new D3 training chip • Tech: Chip packaging becomes the AI battleground, per Reuters — near $28B in spending this year • Gaming: Final Fantasy Resonance launched today, the first HD-2D Final Fantasy • Gaming: SENDESCHLUSS, a free new point-and-click adventure for the Amiga 1200, launched via the FABULA toolkit • Homelab: Proxmox gains Lightbits NVMe-over-TCP shared storage — free plugin, commercial storage • Stocks A: Midday — Nasdaq 100 up 1.57%, S&P 500 up 0.74%, Dow flat, VIX easing toward 26.8 • Stocks B: Nvidia and Micron bounced about 5%; Datadog up 1.8% at $177.82 late morning • Local: North Andover Middle School civics projects turned into real local change in the Merrimack Valley • Local: Highlands group — Friday food pantry, 11:30-12:30, Christ Jubilee on Smith Street in Lowell • Local: Merrimack Valley Eats — Funniest Person Contest night 4 Saturday at the Hungry Traveler in Salisbury

item.title: Morning briefing — Friday, November 6
item.description: Stories in this edition: • Lead: Wall Street rout on Nov 5 — Dow -3.44% to 51,523.06, S&P 500 -4.36% to 7,353.73, Nasdaq -5.52% to 24,315 into correction, tied to fears a Democratic Congress slows the AI buildout; chips led • World: Hoax bomb threats disrupted at least 27 passenger flights across Europe on Thursday per Reuters — fighter escorts, Aer Lingus Dublin-Rome diverted to Évreux, no explosives found, no suspect named • World: Bank of England hikes Bank Rate 25bp to 4% in an 8-1 vote, first hike since 2023 — inflation 3.5% in September, forecast near 5% by mid-2027 on energy prices • World: France nationwide strike over wages and living costs — Interior Ministry says about 600,000 in nearly 200 demonstrations, CGT says near 1.6 million; Eiffel Tower closed • World: Fire at an industrial facility in Afipsky, Krasnodar region after a drone attack per Reuters/local emergency services — town hosts a major oil refinery; separate strikes on Ukraine killed 1 and injured 3, details still coming in • US: California Gov. Gavin Newsom to commute all 548 death sentences to life without parole — largest mass commutation in US history per Death Penalty Information Center; law stays, hundreds need state Supreme Court review • US: Record wave of health experts on midterm ballots — at least 125 doctors, nurses and public health experts; pediatrician Annie Andrews wins a South Carolina Senate seat, Amy Acton wins Ohio governorship • US: Missouri voters reject a ban on abortion and gender-affirming care for minors; Nevada and Virginia approve abortion-rights referendums, per reporting cited by KFF Health News • Sports: Cristiano Ronaldo retires from international football at 41 — record 234 caps and 146 goals for Portugal per Reuters; continues club football with Al-Nassr • Fun fact: Detached scarlet sea cucumber fragments kept living for more than three years — healed, absorbed nutrients from seawater without a mouth, and showed no signs of aging • Tech: Microsoft declines an option to more than double its Texas Nscale data center deal per FT via Reuters — existing contract stands; Nebius and IREN fell over 16%, CoreWeave about 12% • Tech: Nvidia releases Cosmos 3 — four open world models, 16B parameters, for simulating self-driving cars and robots, licensed for commercial use • Gaming: EA returns 25 classic PC games to Steam, GOG and the EA app — 7 Anniversary restorations including Road Rash and Wing Commander with FMV restored from master tapes, plus 18 faithful ports including Ultima and Theme Hospital • Homelab: Proxmox VE 9.2's dynamic load balancer automatically migrates VMs and containers off lopsided nodes; TOPSIS mode favors memory over CPU, per XDA • Stocks: VIX jumped from 16.61 to 28.18 on Thursday; Nasdaq 100 futures bounced about 1% this morning and Brent rebounded near $99 a barrel • Stocks: Datadog closed down 7.48% at $174.60 from a $188.72 previous close; Nvidia fell about 9.3%, AMD 17.3%, and the semiconductor index more than 12% • Local: 19-year-old UMass Lowell student Daniel Darris-O'Connor of Billerica beats longtime Republican incumbent Marc Lombardo by 438 votes for a Massachusetts House seat, per CNN and other reports • Local: Lowell residents press the City Council on Flock license-plate cameras — council votes to release executive-session minutes and sends data-sharing review to the city manager • Local: Lowell Highlands group warns against anticoagulant rat poison on properties, citing pets, kids and wildlife, with alternatives listed in comments

item.title: Evening briefing — Thursday, November 5
item.description: Stories in this edition: • Wall Street meltdown erases post-election rally — Nasdaq down 5.52%, chip index sinks ~12% • Bank of England raises rates to 4%, first hike since 2023, warns more may come • British health care worker with Ebola evacuated from DR Congo to UK for specialist treatment • Saudi Arabia signs defense agreement with Syria with $403M+ in development loans • Data-center construction loses all 41 tracked local ballot measures across eight states • CVS plans to split its pharmacies from Aetna and Caremark in early 2028 • Lancet study: federal cuts projected to double marketplace insurance costs, SNAP down 4.5M participants • Unhinged fun fact: scarlet sea cucumber fragments stayed alive for 3+ years with no mouth or body • Anthropic says Claude helped solve the 3D structure of a bacteriophage vault particle • OpenAI to acquire Pierre Computer; Meta acquires coding startup Conductor • Zelda: Ocarina of Time remake launches on Switch 2; Amazon physical preorders delayed • EA releases 25 classics on Steam, including Road Rash and Wing Commander anniversary editions • Home Assistant 2026.11 stable: HACS becomes built-in Marketplace, Matter 1.5 cameras • Stocks close: Dow -1,833 to 51,523; S&P 500 -4.36%; Nasdaq -5.52% into correction • Datadog closes down 7.48% at $174.60 as analysts cut targets but keep buy ratings; Brent rebounds 2.43% to $96.92 • Lowell Highlands neighbors urge end to anticoagulant rodent poisons over pets and wildlife • Haverhill Winter Farmers Market: ~40 vendors, third Saturdays Nov-Feb, first on Nov 21

item.title: Midday briefing — Thursday, November 5
item.description: Stories in this edition: • Ukraine aid center death toll in Komyshuvakha rises to 42 after Russian bombing • France national strike disrupts rail over 2027 budget • Poland arrests four accused of spying for Russian intelligence • North Korea says it tested a new anti-aircraft missile system and cruise missile drill • House Speaker Mike Johnson to step down as Republican leader after midterm defeat • Gunman killed by security guard after fatal shooting at Citibank campus near Tampa; 4 hurt, motive unreleased • NASA Swift telescope reenters atmosphere after failed rescue boost • Unhinged fun fact: giant 30kg rodent named from two teeth found in Thailand • OpenAI agents find 948 ways to gain root access to Linux for about $1.2M • Google patches critical zero-click Android flaw in November update • Godzilla: Destroy All Monsters Melee Remastered out for modern consoles and PC • New Game Boy Color racer Zero releases today on itch.io • Proxmox 9.2 dynamic load balancer auto-rebalances cluster resources • Midday markets split: Nasdaq -1.99%, S&P 500 -0.95%, Dow +0.11% • Datadog slides again midday near $179.56, down about 4.85%, as Needham holds $300 target • 19-year-old UMass Lowell student Daniel Darris-O'Connor wins Massachusetts State House seat by 438 votes • Lowell-based MACOM beats Q4 estimates: $2.09 EPS on $424.82M revenue, up 62.6% year over year

item.title: Morning briefing — Thursday, November 5
item.description: Stories in this edition: • Lead: Russia says it struck logistics and transport targets across Ukraine overnight — Reuters reports a Nova Poshta hub in Kharkiv region, rail locomotives, a power plant building, a southern power station and a cargo vessel near Odesa; Russia's drone-assembly claim is unverified • World: Hong Kong activist Joshua Wong sentenced to 10 more years after pleading guilty to foreign collusion under the national security law, per Reuters — behind bars since 2020, he will be 40 on release • World: Iran's Revolutionary Guards claim tankers hit mines and caught fire near Hormuz — no vessel named and no navy or tracker has confirmed it; UK officials confirmed a separate projectile strike off Oman on Tuesday • World: Delhi's air quality index hit 377 on Wednesday morning ahead of Diwali — deep in the very poor range • US: Democrats vow to rein in Trump per Reuters — at least 54 Senate seats after flipping seven, with Alaska and Mississippi still uncalled and a possible 56-seat majority; Trump showed off his White House ballroom • US: NTSB says key parts from a Florida aircraft crash were found about three miles from the site, meaning they detached before impact • US: Milwaukee Brewers celebrate their first World Series championship with a downtown parade and rally after beating Toronto • Fun fact: A day on Venus is longer than its year — about 243 Earth days to spin once versus about 225 days to orbit the Sun, and it spins backwards • Tech: Anthropic files to go public — $16.3B in first-half revenue, nearly $1B operating profit in one quarter, and Claude writing over 90% of its production code • Tech: Microsoft offers buyouts to about 60,000 employees, roughly 27% of its workforce, as AI infrastructure spending tops $50B a quarter • Gaming: GTA 6 preload moves up to November 10 — up to 212GB, ahead of the November 19 launch • Gaming: A JVC X'Eye retro console returns from a full service — both boards recapped, new laser, and FRAM saves • Homelab: Proxmox adds native Lightbits NVMe-over-TCP shared storage integration for Proxmox VE • Stocks: Brent crude fell below $94 a barrel this morning, extending a near-9% slide, and the dollar softened against the euro and pound • Stocks: Datadog slipped about 0.4% after hours to $187.90 after closing down 14.42% despite an earnings beat; consumer discretionary led near +4% and energy lagged near -4.7% • Local: InsideLowell — Vanna Howard wins with about 58%, Lorena Betts wins the 16th Middlesex seat, and Ralph Hogan and Brady McCarron take the Greater Lowell Tech committee seats, after slow counting from multi-page ballots • Local: Lowell City Council unanimously approves $1.5M to hire 14 firefighters — department at 196 against a 213 target amid station brownouts • Local: Lowell Highlands group shares a Support Local Crafters Black Friday event at Tyngsboro Sports Center, 10am-3pm

item.title: Evening briefing — Wednesday, November 4
item.description: Stories in this edition: • Lead: Tampa Citibank Center shooting — woman killed, four injured, gunman killed by security guard; sheriff calls it targeted, developing • World: Indonesia's president sacks chief of staff arrested in wiretapping scandal; troops mobilised in Jakarta • World: North Korea fires missiles toward the sea while denying FBI's Binance hack claim • World: Europe supermarket fridge hacks, second wave — defrost mode, spoiled food, default passwords suspected • US: Kentucky measles cases pass 200, at 204 confirmed for the year • US: Michigan's 7th District flips — AP calls it for Will Lawrence, Barrett concedes • US: Rep. Massie could force House vote on impeaching Defense Secretary Hegseth as early as Nov 9 • Fun fact: Wombats poop stackable cubes, up to 100 a night, formed in the intestine • Tech: Qualcomm earnings — revenue down 8%, handset chips down 26%, auto chips up 89% • Tech: Alphabet rebounds about 4% after last week's $500B selloff; Google Cloud revenue doubled • Gaming: God of War Laufey delayed from Feb 16 to May 20, 2027 • Gaming: Zelda Ocarina remake physical preorders stuck by Nintendo's Nov 4 shipping embargo; digital unlocks at midnight • Homelab: Proxmox 9.2's overlooked dynamic load balancer auto-rebalances clusters, TOPSIS mode • Stocks: Dow +3.03% to 53,356 (biggest post-midterm rally in 44 years), S&P +1.58%, Nasdaq +1.44% • Stocks: Brent crude -8.7% to ~$94.62; Datadog closes -14.42% at $188.72 on flat guidance • Local: CVS, founded as a single Lowell store in 1963, plans to spin off its pharmacy business in 2028 • Local: Merrimack Valley Eats — Steampunk Station brings back its chicken marsala today • Local: Lowell Highlands group — free queen-size bed frame offered this afternoon

item.title: Midday briefing — Wednesday, November 4
